mentions.question: How does RealPage compare to Yardi for multifamily property management?

mentions.name: Claude + web search
mentions.question: How does RealPage compare to Yardi for enterprise property management?
sentences: - California's AB 325, effective January 2026, bans AI-driven rent-pricing algorithms that facilitate collusion — with similar laws now in New York, New Jersey, and eight cities.

- RealPage and several major landlord clients (Equity Residential, Camden, MAA, Greystar, etc.) have agreed to ~$360 million in class-action settlements (as of 2026) over allegations that YieldStar facilitated rent price-fixing between 2018–2025.
- [Apartment owners to pay $218M in second batch of RealPage settlements](https://www.multifamilydive.com/news/realpage-settlement-algorithmic-pricing/820745/)
- [$359.9M RealPage antitrust class action settlement](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/open-lawsuit-settlements/359-9m-realpage-antitrust-class-action-settlement/)
- [RealPage Lawsuit 2026: Rent Fixing Case Updates](https://lawhighlights.com/realpage-lawsuit/)

mentions.name: Claude + web search
mentions.question: Which is better for resident screening: RealPage, Entrata, or Appfolio?
sentences: - Caution: RealPage has a track record of regulatory trouble tied to screening accuracy — it paid a $3M FTC settlement over faulty criminal-background matching (false-positive matches based on loose name/DOB matching) that wrongly flagged applicants as having criminal records.
It's also currently facing separate DOJ/state antitrust scrutiny over its rent-pricing algorithm (a different product line, but it's worth knowing when evaluating the company overall).

- [$3 million FCRA settlement puts tenant background screening at the forefront - FTC](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/blog/2018/10/3-million-fcra-settlement-puts-tenant-background-screening-forefront)
